name: table-empty-state-premium
title: Upgrade empty table-management setup state
description: Replace the sparse and visually broken no-floor state with a compact sage/cream setup flow while preserving existing table and floor behavior.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: The backend floor/table flow was already correct. The final CSS layer repairs the legacy .tm-empty span collision with Button.btn__text and adds a responsive sage/cream onboarding layout. Focused tests and build were not executed in the connected environment; GitHub reported no workflow run for the final code commit.
